name: @singularity/plugin-network-live-filter
description: The one filter language: a closed set of column domains (text, number, boolean, instant, stringArray), ONE op table whose entries carry their in-memory test and a dialect-free SQL template side by side (negatives only via complementOf), and the Filter expression (clauses under and/or, no not) with its canonical form, strict codec and in-memory matchesFilter. server: renderOpSql / filterSql compile it to drizzle SQL over rendered targets.
